shots.name: incoming-damage
shots.title: Incoming Damage
shots.caption: What the enemies' next turn costs you: incoming damage, your block at end of turn, and what you'll lose.

shots.name: proc-tabs
shots.title: Proc Indicators
shots.caption: Each tab is a power or relic that playing the card sets off right now, with the block or damage it adds.

shots.name: warnings
shots.title: Crossed tabs: warnings
shots.caption: A red slash means playing the card might cost you: Thorns hitting back, or giving up Art of War's energy.

shots.name: card-indicators
shots.title: Card Indicators
shots.caption: Retain, Sly, double plays (here Burst on Skills) and Ethereal cards, readable on the top edge of the card.

shots.name: shuffle-warning
shots.title: Shuffle Warning
shots.caption: The discard pile tab: this card's draws would reshuffle your discard pile mid-turn.

shots.name: relic-counters
shots.title: Relic Counters
shots.caption: One row per counter relic: progress, and a flash when the next card fires it.

shots.name: potion-tabs
shots.title: Potion Tabs
shots.caption: Tabs under your potions for the relics that drinking them sets off.

shots.name: imbalanced
shots.title: Stuns and wake-ups
shots.caption: Imbalanced, Burrowed, Flutter and Asleep: the tab shows when your card stuns the enemy or wakes it up.

shots.name: event
shots.title: Run Reminders: events
shots.caption: Beside event options: the relics that change what each option does, with the chance a card relic applies.

shots.name: map
shots.title: Run Reminders: map
shots.caption: On the map legend: your relics that make a kind of room unusually good or bad.

shots.name: settings
shots.title: Settings and Guide
shots.caption: Every feature, tab and tracker row can be switched on or off (F10).

shots.name: guide
shots.title: Settings and Guide
shots.caption: The in-game Guide explains every mark with live examples.

shots.name: update-notice
shots.title: Update Notice
shots.caption: On the main menu: a note when a newer Spire QoL is out (or that you're up to date), and a gear for the settings.

shots.name: overview
shots.title: Overview
shots.caption: Tabs on your cards, what you'll take this turn, and your relic counters, all at a glance.

shots.name: lethal
shots.title: Lethal
shots.caption: The skull: playing this card kills that enemy before it acts, in every outcome. The arrow means it depends on where you aim.

shots.name: death-skull
shots.title: Death Skull
shots.caption: The skull beside an enemy's HP: it dies before it acts if you end your turn now.

shots.name: intent-forecast
shots.title: Intent Forecast
shots.caption: Hover an enemy's intent to see the moves its rules make certain, and the odds when it picks at random.

shots.name: card-reward
shots.title: Run Reminders: card rewards
shots.caption: On a card reward: a tab on each offered card one of your relics makes stronger in fights (here Strike Dummy on the Strikes).

shots.name: shop
shots.title: Run Reminders: shops
shots.caption: In the shop: the relics that buying each item sets off, beside its price.

shots.name: rest-preview
shots.title: Rest Preview
shots.caption: At a rest site: what resting heals with your relics, and how much of it would be wasted.
